about.title: Biography
about.subtitle: A craftsman who brings traditional artistry together with modern design
about.p1: Furkan Çiçekli's passion for the art of prayer beads began at an early age. Over the years he learned the craft from master artisans and developed a style of his own.
about.p2: He works with amber, kuka, jet stone and many other precious materials; each prayer bead comes to life through carefully selected materials and meticulous craftsmanship.
about.p3: The years he spent in Kuwait introduced him to different cultures' understanding of prayer beads and enriched his technique.
